title: Letter and Uniform
author: E. M. Voss
blurb: Marguerite Sandoval, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, keeps a low profile and busy hands. But when the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
